svg.title: Choosing the eviction boundary from the cache first
svg.desc: Evicting before consulting the cache produces a boundary at token zero, which no checkpoint can align to. Asking the cache first and evicting after it preserves a reusable prefix. Every plan ends in one of four reported verdicts, and the fallback path always produces a correct plan.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The eviction boundary is chosen before the eviction

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Order of operations is the whole design. Get it wrong and every compaction silently reports a full re-prefill.
